why: bugs.md #18: D2R names the Uber Tristram monsters (classes 704-709) by class, not by the monstats NameStr; class 707 (uberandariel, Median's Pandora) always reads D2R's key Lilith. Median 2012 uses no other D2R Lilith string.

bugs.md #508 (owner ruling 2026-10-30): Median reuses Baal's laugh (voice file baallaugh1) as a sound on many skills and missiles (Spawn Edyrem of dark_master1/2 and evil4spw, Spawn Dragon, Belial Volcano ...); D2R prints its vo.json line as "Baal says: *Laughing*" each time. The owner wants "Baal says: LOL" (also Baal's own laugh in the Throne); plugin part vochat limits the line to once every 30 s.

bugs.md #528: D2RLoader's Ctrl stat-range tooltip (D2RCore item_stat_ranges) starts each "Possible base rolls" line with this key, D2R's "\u2022 ". The classic (legacy graphics) font has no bullet glyph and draws a crossed-out box instead; a hyphen draws in both fonts.

Owner request 2026-11-06 (player): the automap's top-right text shows the area level. D2R's line for a terror zone ("Terrorized: %d") is the one mxl2012-core part arealvl fills with levels.txt MonLvlEx of the current area and difficulty when the area is not terrorized (area_level.cpp); Median 2012 has no terror zones.

text: Keep in Inventory or Charm Inventory to Gain Bonus
why: CharmInv (Dimentio's D2RLoader plugin, bundled; docs/bundled-plugins.md): owner decision 2026-11-10, charms grant their bonus from the normal inventory and from the Charm Inventory (charm-inv.toml allow_inventory_charms = true). CharmInv's own strings.json says "Keep in Charm Inventory to Gain Bonus"; Median's .tbl says "Keep in Inventory to Gain Bonus". Mod overrides win over plugin overrides, so this text names both places.
